head: 468142038fdcc41b353a873e5a28cc4a9c4320a7
status: short gates passed; production guest context remains untested
observations: Linux and Windows each passed 710 required tests with zero skips, not a full-repository claim. Actual Windows SDK compilation, fixed parser/normalization helper tests, composed raw-vs-qualified result tests, isolated production-input verification and existing PS/ZIP gates passed.

Hosted TEST_ONLY IPv6 loopback exercised WSARecvMsg, IPV6_PKTINFO and IP Helper context queries. All 46 native rows report complete observed/passed context masks [1,1023,1023]. Main phases produced 45 exact echoes; the separate wrong-echo row passed peer context but rejected payload while preserving accepted send. This exercises the explicit loopback branch, not production site-zone or QEMU-MAC admission.

Synthetic helper contracts separately passed malformed ancillary, scope normalization and interface cases. They are not observations of a Windows guest site Zone. Raw nonce-payload observation is separately typed from qualified echo; post-context/cleanup preservation tests use controlled fixtures.

Seven held child exits/handles and two receiver socket/thread cleanups and work removal are true, with no kills. Hosted profile-only observes non-AppContainer identity; contained is a fixture phase, not PSEC. Production actor executed invalid CLI only; isolated verifier executed no PE.

PowerShell checks 78/48/60/57 and six-mode ZIP 66 checks with 12 forbidden substitutions passed. These mocked/inert boundaries do not establish actual guest transport or production payload fit. Both platforms passed 56 inert Bash vectors with six expected successes and 50 expected refusals.
Linux tiny paused QEMU provenance and cleanup passed; mapped backing-file/local-package agreement is separate from resident bytes or upstream-source equivalence. No guest ran.
limits: The prior instrumented guest run identified a nonzero returned scope rejected by the old zero-scope predicate. Its payload comparison was not reached; the first guest run hidden cause remains unknown. Both receipts remain unchanged.

Version2 changes the receive-context acceptance explicitly: stable independently derived interface/site-zone plus actual ancillary ingress index replaces zero-scope acceptance. Fixed endpoint, identity/policy, sends, original deadlines and global network/QEMU settings remain unchanged. No arbitrary nonzero scope or missing context is accepted.

Production expected nonzero site Zone is conservative fixture admission, not universal Windows validity. Local packet destination is sanity-checked, not independently validated against an address ownership table. Hosted loopback exceptions are compile-time TEST_ONLY and cannot certify production guest context.

No guest runtime, IPv6 isolation/absence, DNS/proxy/descendant IPv6/Linux/product acceptance follows. No raw indices/LUIDs/MACs/zones/addresses/ports/PIDs/nonces/credentials/PCAP/private bundle are published. Any guest attempt requires a separate decision and unchanged pre-QEMU/provenance/ordinary-echo admissions.
